purpose: Evidence-based closure ledger for every P0 gap in the fully functional AI path.
rules: gap closure is a decision backed by evidence, never inferred from file existence
ready_for_closure requires all dependency gaps closed and all required evidence present
closed requires the canonical gap status to be closed and associated blueprint status implemented/complete
a closed gap is reopened when dependent evidence becomes invalid after a lower-stage contract regression
evidence references must identify executable tests, repository artifacts, migration/restore proof, or release/golden-journey receipts
progress metadata is informative until validator-backed closure conditions are satisfied
